description: Cream opaque low-square-neck court gown with burgundy-and-gold layered borders, fitted bodice, shaped sleeves ending near elbows, rich gold front embroidered panel and floor-length layered skirt with a narrow below-knee walking opening. Small jeweled shoulder brooches, fine belt with round clasp, and burgundy-and-cream wrap resting around the arms. Earrings and gold-toned shoes. Both hands together in front; full hairstyle and shoe tips inside frame, one foot mostly hidden by hem. No headgear, armor, weapon or text.
